issues.problem:
Round 4's text makes these statements:
- §4.3: 'so no hidden part, no id, no whole design's move and no turn a mirror image rewrites decides'.
- §4.4: 'a mirror image reverses only kept parts tied but for the sign of their place ... and cleaned parts of one material tied but for the sign of their place'.

E-S2.14 and M3-notes ('a turn decides only between parts that stand together') are right. Reviewer V1 independently reports the same (his Major B: crossed at 30 and 70 degrees, 1.4e-5 to 2.1e-5 kg).
